name: ShippingGuard – Shipping Protection
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
ShippingGuard is a simple WooCommerce plugin that adds an optional Shipping Protection fee to the customer’s cart.
It integrates directly into your WooCommerce checkout, allowing you to easily offer shipping protection to your customers.

Features:
* Simple settings page to enable or disable the shipping protection fee.
* Ability to set a custom flat fee amount.
* Lightweight, secure, and fast.
* Fully integrates natively with WooCommerce cart fees.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shippingguard directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> ShippingGuard Settings to configure the protection fee amount and enable it.
sections.faq:
Does it work with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes, it is regularly tested with the latest stable versions of WooCommerce.

Is changing the fee amount possible?

Yes, you can easily change the fee amount from the plugin’s settings page.
